findings.detail: Classification block trusts status=classified without validating the returned dataClass or noAiAccess shape. An unknown dataClass plus noAiAccess:false passes evaluateProtectedData as ordinary and runs the observe.read executor once.
Classification block does not bind returned record.tenantId to classificationTenant. The probe returned an acme ordinary record for a contoso task; the runtime completed and called the executor once.

createProtectedDataGuard().evaluate prefers caller-supplied record over registry resolution. A caller can pass an ordinary record while target is policy-bundle (registry says retention-locked), making an agent delete decision allow.

createRuntimeLogObserver accepts an event without classifying it and appendSystem copies summary/objective/target into observation.value. Direct call with S1_02_SECRET_CANARY then ledger.read returned the canary verbatim.
